answer: Give every agent a public mirror ledger of its past work: a new identity starts with zero standing and must earn a costly, time-stamped signal of useful, independently verified tasks before it can transact. Copying an identity a hundred times costs a hundred times the work, and each copy's history stays visible, so a fake cluster cannot borrow reputation from its siblings. A sable audit pool then re-checks old entries at random; any entry that fails burns the agent's escrow and flags its mirror, making mass forgery unprofitable.
